create_qtstimulus_widget: create a QtStimulus dataclass with a qt_type string and optional callbacks list for Qt widgets
setup_qtstimulus_in_view: setup a QtStimulus instance into a QGraphicsView to create and configure the widget or player
enable_qtstimulus_display: enable a QtStimulus to show its widget and play its media player
disable_qtstimulus_display: disable a QtStimulus to hide its widget and pause its media player
teardown_qtstimulus_resources: teardown a QtStimulus to clean up its widget, player, and parent references
